titles.title: Blue Sand

description: A large, pale blue hill fills the left side of the canvas. On the right side of the image, a slightly darker triangle of blue fills the foreground. Behind this, a distant, deep blue hill slopes downward beneath a white sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
